evals.prompt: Give me a command to list only proxied A records for example.com using profile staging, with deterministic filtering. Do not contact my account.
evals.expected_output: Explicitly scoped cf DNS list command using type/proxied filters and all-match semantics, with pagination caveat; no account access.
expectations: Uses cf dns records list with --zone example.com and --profile staging.
Uses --type A, --proxied true, and --match all rather than fuzzy search.
Explains pagination and does not claim account access or a complete first-page inventory.

evals.prompt: Prepare a DNS-only A record for api.example.com pointing at 192.0.2.10 with TTL 300 using profile staging. Show the preview and actual command, but do not execute either.
evals.expected_output: Zone/profile-scoped DNS create commands with JSON body and dry-run preview; verifies zone intent and distinguishes proposal from execution.
expectations: Uses cf dns records create scoped to example.com and staging, identifying the inferred zone.
Provides valid JSON body with type A, name api.example.com, content 192.0.2.10, ttl 300, and proxied false.
Separates --dry-run preview from live command and does not execute either.
Advises confirming target and checking existing records before an authorized change.

evals.prompt: Plan how to list every R2 object under reports/ in bucket example-archive using profile staging. Explain how to retrieve subsequent pages; do not contact my account.
evals.expected_output: Prefix-scoped R2 list commands and returned-cursor continuation until exhaustion without invented response fields or automatic-pagination claims.
expectations: Uses cf r2 objects list with bucket example-archive, prefix reports/, and profile staging.
Shows --cursor continuation while preserving the original scope.
Explains repeating with returned cursors until exhausted without asserting automatic pagination or inventing response fields.
Does not contact the account or claim real inventory results.
